TASK_MATRIX.TASK: Binary archaeology fallback exists through aligned metadata DTOs and emergency mock scan data; no managed dictionary or split path in scanner hot loop.
Physics queries eradicated from SHINOBU_24 runtime; scanner uses vault-backed bucket arrays plus line/sphere math.
ActiveScanStateDTO uses raw fields and ref mutation via NativeArray memory; no get/set properties on array DTOs.
ScannableEntityMetadataDTO remains 16 bytes; support DTOs were reordered for 8-byte ARM64 lane alignment.
MockSpatialHashGrid, MockScannerInputSignal, MockToolTransformSignal, MockToolTransformSignalJob, and MockSdfOcclusionZoneDTO isolate flora/fauna/tool dependencies.
ScannerSpatialQueryJob is Burst-compatible, bounded by max cell/candidate settings, and uses O(1) bucket lookup without Unity physics.
ScannerScanProgression mutates unmanaged active state and decays when target lock is lost.
Dear Lie occlusion uses one midpoint SDF sphere sample instead of a wall raycast.
Completion emits typed EncyclopediaUnlockSignal, ScanCompleteSignal, and existing scan discovery route by uint hash.
Multiple target disambiguation uses distance plus forward-dot score; no sorting and no hit arrays.
Quality tier and SystemHealthIndex throttle reacquisition cadence; progression remains separate from query cadence.
AUP math subtracts double3 positions first, then narrows local delta to float3 for ray/sphere tests.
ScannerVfxDTO is a 32-byte vault export; visuals do not query scanner internals.
Depletable metadata emits EntityDepletedSignal and ResourceDepletionDeltaSignal; scanner does not mutate world objects directly.
Progress and completion emit typed acoustic signals; scanner owns no AudioSource.
Active state reset uses UnsafeUtility.MemClear and does not allocate.
300-frame ScannerTelemetryEntry ring is vault-owned and dumps to Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_SHINOBU_24.bin plus Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_SHINOBU_24.h8dump on NaN/budget breach.
DataMiningTunerWindow reads/writes ScannerSettingsDTO through GlobalDataVault during Play Mode when available.
Zero-GC line parser updates unmanaged metadata durations. Continuous disk watching is intentionally not in the player hot path; file IO must be supplied by a cold/background bridge.
Editor SceneView visualizer draws yellow cone, red lock line, and blue hit sphere from scanner/VFX data.
